paragraphs: PlaySight sells a connected camera platform that turns courts, gyms, rinks and facilities into a SmartCourt venue. Fixed and portable camera systems record practices, games, matches and tournaments without cabling or network infrastructure. The platform adds live streaming, automated production, instant replay and player development tools on top of the cameras.

Its pages name athletes, coaches, teams and leagues as the users of that platform. The technology is installed on padel, pickleball and tennis courts around the world, alongside partners across professional and collegiate sports. Clients quoted on the homepage include the Boston Celtics, Auburn University and the Mountain West Conference.

The about page says the platform delivers the same experience to athletes and coaches in 30+ sports in over 35 countries. Examples on that page run from the Toronto Raptors to LakePoint Sports to Santa Margarita High School.

quote.text: Whether you are an NBA player, a college coach or an aspiring junior in tennis – the PlaySight platform was built for you.
